videos.title: The Best Shoulder Lock from the Back
videos.whyUseful: Clear breakdown of the Thunder Lock shoulder submission from back control, plus a stronger alternative shoulder lock.

videos.title: The THUNDER LOCK is a powerful submission!
videos.whyUseful: Direct Thunder Lock demonstration from Jordan Teaches Jiujitsu, useful as a concise visual companion to the detailed back-control mechanics.

videos.title: Elijah Dorsey's Thunder Lock From WNO | Technique Breakdown
videos.whyUseful: Competition breakdown of the Thunder Lock finish as seen in the WNO black belt division.

videos.title: Take The Back, Then Finish With This Shoulder Lock.
videos.whyUseful: Shows the back-control shoulder lock applied when the opponent defends the choke, using the arm-behind-the-head lever.

videos.title: Simple submissions....switching Half Nelson to a shoulder lock
videos.whyUseful: Covers the further-nelson lineage — switching a half nelson into a shoulder lock — which is the same mechanical family as the Thunder Lock.
